title: Lanework relation
description: A relation's `index.md` under a card's `relations/<uuid>/`: a typed, directed statement the card makes about another item, stored once on the card that makes it. No `title` and no `order`; the body is an optional rationale.

created.description: When the relation was stated, and by whom.

modified.description: The last write to the relation, its `suspect` included.

rel.description: Required. The relation's type, free text (`traces-to`, `depends-on`, `supersedes`). The app attaches no meaning to it and the board declares none; it is shown as written, prettified.

to.description: Required. The target: any `lanework://` link — a card usually, but a board, lane, comment or attachment too. Resolved exactly as written; a target the app cannot resolve is shown as unresolved and kept unchanged. Write the full form; a short link is legal and resolves by prefix.

suspect.description: The relation needs re-checking because something it depends on changed. Set and removed by agents; the app only displays it.
